enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an oceanfront RV park and cottage resort in Campbell River, BC. The RV park page details amenities including hot showers, heated washrooms, laundry facility, wheelchair-accessible washrooms/shower, fire pits, and full hookups. The front page confirms walking distance to restaurants and breweries. Reservations are accepted via online booking and phone. No mention of hiker/biker sites, tent camping, or cyclist-specific amenities was found anywhere on the site — it explicitly welcomes 'all sizes of RVs, trailers, and campervans' with no mention of tents. Phone (250-286-3344) and full address (2660 Spit Road, Campbell River, BC V9W 6E3) are confirmed on multiple website pages.
